newsitem.title: USA: Guidant Ventak system implanted in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Guidant Ventak system implanted in Europe.

text.p: Guidant Corp said Tuesday the first of seven implants of the Ventak AV Acide Automatic Implantable Cardioverter Defibrillator system occurred in Europe.
The system, manufactured by CPI, which is part of Guidant's Cardiac Rhythm Management group, is designed for treating patients with life-threatening rapid heart arrhythmias.
It takes signals from the heart's upper chamber in a way that enhances the specificity of treatment strategies for ventricular arrhythmias, Guidant said.
